title: Model 2 track-history correction on Sargassum-like suites: not confirmed
scope: Pre-registered test of the drifter-fitted track-history settings on three Sargassum-relevant suites: GPS-tracked mats off Puerto Rico in 2018, Sargassum-like mat drifters, and Stokes drifters.
summary: The settings did not confirm at 48 h on any of the three suites. Puerto Rico GPS mats: -2.25 km (-8%), interval -7.92 to +3.35 km (125 cases, 4 tracks). Sargassum-like mat drifters: +3.51 km (+14%, worse), interval -1.86 to +7.02 (85 cases, 8 tracks). Stokes drifters: +2.54 km (+11%, worse), interval +0.07 to +6.17 (532 cases, 14 tracks). On Puerto Rico GPS the 24 h gain was large (-4.07 km, -25%, interval -6.21 to -1.92) but was a secondary outcome on a repeatedly scored benchmark.
limitations: The source report is an untracked working-tree file; it is identified by SHA-256 only and has no source commit.
Settings were frozen from the open-Caribbean drifter fits; a shorter fade or lower strength is untested and must be chosen without reusing these suites.
The GPS suite is four tracks over 18 days in one season, scored many times before, and its interpolated positions may leak later fixes.
These suites have now been looked at and cannot serve as clean holdouts for retuning.
